premises.text: Partner alarms fragment co-sleepers' sleep and leave the woken partner groggy; couples want a fix
premises.evidence_span: There are two fundamental problems with the way we wake up. One, I get my sleep continually disrupted and fragmented, leaving me with less and poor-quality sleep. And two, my boyfriend is woken up in the most ineffective way possible, leaving him feeling groggy all day

premises.text: LarkUp wakes via a silent wristband nudge paired with a phone app set like a normal alarm and docked as a nightstand clock
premises.evidence_span: You do the same thing just with our Lark app. Set it for the time, and then you just stick it onto your Lark dock. This sits on your nightstand, and it becomes your nighttime alarm clock

premises.text: Wake tech feels natural and is substantially more peaceful than a regular alarm, avoiding the adrenaline jolt
premises.evidence_span: It's two and a half times more peaceful than a regular alarm

premises.text: Wristband is styled to be beautiful, simple, and comfortable with no on-band UI
premises.evidence_span: make it beautiful, simple, comfortable, of a wristband
